title: 第6章
content_zh:
医院里，贺以诚到最后，才跟昏迷中的明秀低声说了句：“这些年，我心里从没有过另一个人。”
他没说自己后不后悔，也没问明秀后没后悔，青春早已流逝，人生有限，谁也不能在时间的河流中回溯。
站在抢救室外头的，除了他，还有展有庆，展有庆什么也不懂，一脸闷相，可他哭了，肩膀一抖一抖的，贺以诚冷漠地扫过去两眼，他走到窗户那，想抽根烟，可怎么也点不着火。
展有庆带明秀回家前，扑通一声，给贺以诚跪了，他淌着眼泪说：“贺老板，大恩不言谢，我给您磕个头吧。”
男儿膝下有黄金，跪天跪地跪父母，展有庆这一跪，是算着什么都一笔勾销。
贺以诚跟他无话可说，他头疼，眼睛干干的，回到家倒头一觉睡到第二天黄昏。
妻子林美娟是美院的老师，正在假期中，见贺以诚不对劲，交代贺图南千万不要惹爸爸生气。
“以诚，你起来吃点东西。”林美娟做好了饭，喊不起他，贺以诚睡的书房，衣裳都没脱，她担心他睡得难受。
饭桌上，一家人沉默地吃着东西，林美娟什么都没问，贺以诚这个人，有什么事如果自己不主动说，别人再怎么问，他也不会说。
她只是给他夹菜，说：“这几天菜价明显下来了，过年少买是对的。”
贺以诚一副谈生意的口吻，贺图南习惯了，等吃完饭，父子俩去了书房。
“有件事，我觉得应该提前跟你说一声，你有个心理准备。”贺以诚开门见山。
“我一个老朋友去世了，留下个女儿，无人看管，她现在读初三，等中考一过，我把她接过来，你比她大要喊妹妹，以后什么事都要让着她点儿，这样，”贺以诚顿了顿，“你那间卧室朝阳，到时空出来给妹妹住。”
这话在贺图南听起来，非常□□，就差明言：我外头还有个女儿，现在，我要把她接回来。
他们一家三口，住的是新房。赶在房改前，贺以诚就买了大平层，贺图南的同学，大都还挤在父母单位的福利房里，筒子楼，大家都在过道里做饭，排队上厕所，动辄因为谁偷了谁家的水，谁偷了谁家的电，吵得不可开交。
贺图南小时候也住筒子楼，楼中间是天井，到处堆放着杂物，头顶横着乱七八糟的电线，过道里，则晒着湿漉漉的内衣裤，往下滴水。
那种地方，他记忆不多，因为贺以诚下海很快就带着他离开了那乱哄哄又热闹非凡的地方。
他一直觉得贺以诚像个假人，完美的假人。外人看来，贺以诚这种学历高，出身好，下海发财居然还没有什么包二奶习惯的男人，堪称道德楷模。
贺图南说不出心里什么感觉，仿佛失落，仿佛释然，又好像有些憋闷，原来军大衣裹着的，是个女孩子。
“我会跟她说，不过，你先不用告诉她，我来说。”贺以诚好像很疲惫，他倦倦的，说完起身就走了。

贺图南明白，妈是个有涵养又体贴包容的人，她什么都会接受。所以，她可以最后一个知道。
贺图南在开学前这一晚，失眠了，等他第二天早起，才知道，贺以诚已经开车往乡下去了，说是去参加老朋友的葬礼。
content_en:
In the hospital, He Yicheng finally whispered to the unconscious Mingxiu: "In these years, I have never had another person in my heart."
He didn't say that he didn't regret it later, nor did he ask Mingxiu that he didn't regret it later. Youth has long passed, life is limited, and no one can look back in the river of time.
Standing outside the rescue room, besides him, there was Zhan Youqing. Zhan Youqing didn't understand anything and had a sullen look on his face, but he was crying and his shoulders were shaking. He Yicheng glanced over indifferently. He walked to the window and wanted to smoke a cigarette, but he couldn't light it.
Before Zhan Youqing took Mingxiu home, he knelt down to He Yicheng with a plop. He said with tears in his eyes: "Boss He, I won't thank you for your kindness. I'll kowtow to you."
There is gold under the man's knees. He kneels to the sky and kneels to his parents. Zhan Youqing's kneeling means that everything is written off.
He Yicheng had nothing to say to him. He had a headache and his eyes were dry. He returned home and fell asleep until dusk the next day.
His wife Lin Meijuan was a teacher at the Academy of Fine Arts. During her vacation, she noticed something was wrong with He Yicheng and told He Tunan not to make his father angry.
"Yicheng, get up and have something to eat." Lin Meijuan had cooked the meal and couldn't afford to call him. He Yicheng slept in the study without taking off his clothes. She was worried that he would not sleep well.
At the dinner table, the family ate in silence. Lin Meijuan didn't ask anything. For He Yicheng, if he didn't take the initiative to say anything, he wouldn't say anything no matter how others asked.
She just gave him some vegetables and said, "Vegetable prices have obviously come down these days. It's right to buy less during the New Year."
He Tunan was used to He Yicheng's business-talking tone. After dinner, the father and son went to the study.
"There's something I think I should tell you in advance so that you can be mentally prepared." He Yicheng got straight to the point.
"An old friend of mine passed away and left a daughter unattended. She is currently in the third grade of junior high school. I will pick her up after she passes the high school entrance examination. If you are older than her, you should call her sister and let her do everything in the future. In this way," He Yicheng paused, "Your bedroom faces the sun. When the time comes, it will be available for my sister to live in."
These words sounded very cruel to He Tunan, just saying clearly: I still have a daughter outside, and now, I want to take her back.
They are a family of three and live in a new house. Before the housing reform, He Yicheng bought a large flat. Most of He Tunan's classmates were still crowded in the welfare room of their parents' unit, Tongzilou. Everyone was cooking in the corridor, queuing to go to the toilet, and constantly quarreling over who stole whose water or electricity.
He Tunan also lived in a Tongzi building when he was a child. There was a patio in the middle of the building, with debris piled everywhere, and messy wires hanging above his head. In the corridor, wet underwear was drying in the sun, dripping with water.
He didn't remember much of that kind of place, because He Yicheng quickly took him away from the noisy and lively place when he went to the sea.
He always felt that He Yicheng was like a dummy, a perfect dummy. In the eyes of outsiders, a man like He Yicheng, who has a high degree of education and a good family background, and who has made a fortune in the sea but has no habit of keeping a mistress, can be regarded as a moral model.
He Tunan couldn't explain what he felt in his heart. He seemed lost, relieved, and a little depressed. It turned out that the person wrapped in the military coat was a girl.
"I will tell her, but you don't have to tell her yet, I'll do it for you." He Yicheng seemed to be very tired. After saying this, he stood up and left.
He Tunan understood that her mother was a cultivated, considerate and tolerant person, and she would accept anything. So, she can be the last to know.
He Tunan suffered from insomnia the night before school started. When he got up early the next day, he found out that He Yicheng had driven to the countryside, saying he was going to attend the funeral of an old friend.
